name: read_file
description:
Read an authorized local file. Use path with optional start_line/max_lines; no action or command field. For edits use edit_file with old_str and explicit new_str; for new files use create_file. Restricted access stays within the current source roots; open mode also permits absolute local paths. Returns metadata, readable text and a citation. Page large text with start_line.

For PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF visual inspection, set image_mode="native" and omit line parameters: actual pixels enter the existing visual route after raw-image disclosure approval. Vision-capable models see pixels directly; text models use the configured interpreter. GIF uses its first frame. image_mode="text" forces extraction; OCR is for text extraction. Without image_mode, privacy settings govern native evidence.

PDF/DOCX/PPTX without explicit line parameters also provide original bytes to supported native document routes when privacy permits. Office native input is text-only; PDF can include page images. Explicit line parameters always select extraction only. XLSX uses structured extraction.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

start_line.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default 1)

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default 100)

image_mode.description: native: inspect image pixels after disclosure approval; omit line parameters. text: extraction without pixels. Omitted: follow privacy settings. Applies to PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF (first frame).
